TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 19 - Monday 20th October 2025
Construction of Male and Female Hostels at the Nigerian Law School, Bwari, Abuja

In continuation of projects' flag-off and commissioning, the Nigerian Law School premises will be the venue of the above event.

As usual, traffic is expected to be controlled and monitored by traffic and security personnel during movement of dignitaries.

Deployment time is 0800hrs.

- Head Traffic DRTS.
